description: This file defines utility functions and an API endpoint to handle file uploads in a FastAPI application. It includes a helper to sanitize filenames and an asynchronous function to save uploaded files to local storage, returning relative paths and filenames.

methods.name: str _safe_filename(name: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename to prevent path traversal and restrict to a safe subset of characters.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] save_upload(*, file: UploadFile, subdir: str = "")
methods.description: Asynchronously saves an uploaded file to the local filesystem, generating a secure filename, and returns its relative path and stored filename.

ctags.name: save_upload
ctags.pattern: /^async def save_upload(*, file: UploadFile, subdir: str = "") -> Tuple[str, str]:$/
